context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 140 verified the income received/pending calculation fix. The key bug was that income with selectedDate='2026-04-01' (future month) was being incorrectly parsed and showing as 'Received' instead of not applying. The fix in _parse_selected_date() now properly detects full ISO dates and returns applies=False for future months. Test cases verified: (1) Future-dated Business income shows received=0, pending=0 (not started), (2) Day-number income (selectedDate='15') correctly shows received when day>=15, (3) No-date income shows as pending (intentional), (4) monthly-summary totals are consistent, (5) detail endpoint matches list summary values. Frontend edit routing for Salary type was also verified to go to /job-income (not /other-income).

bug_verification.original_bug: Income with selectedDate='2026-04-01' was showing received=200000 instead of 0
bug_verification.root_cause: int('2026-04-01') failed, fell back to day 1, which is <= current_day, so marked as Received
bug_verification.fix_applied: _parse_selected_date() now checks for '-' in date string and parses full ISO dates
bug_verification.verification: Future-dated income now correctly shows received=0, pending=0, total=0
